name: canvas-reveal-effect
title: Canvas Reveal Effect
blurb: 3D dot matrix that reveals from center using shader animation.
description: Renders a Three.js dot matrix with WebGL shader that animates dots appearing from the center outward. Supports customizable colors, opacity, and animation speed.
use_when: Hero sections, sci-fi aesthetics, or high-impact entrance effects.
avoid_when: Motion-sensitive users (no prefers-reduced-motion); low-end devices (WebGL cost).
a11y: 3D canvas animation only; no interactive elements. Motion-heavy.
